# MindBridge: AI-Powered Mental Health Support Platform

## Project Introduction

MindBridge is a comprehensive mental health support platform designed to provide accessible, AI-powered therapeutic assistance to individuals seeking mental wellness support. The platform combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies with traditional therapeutic approaches to deliver personalized mental health care.

### Purpose Statement
MindBridge aims to democratize mental healthcare by providing 24/7 accessible therapy support through AI-powered chatbots, voice synthesis, and interactive video interfaces, making mental health resources available to underserved populations and those unable to access traditional therapy.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Accessibility**: Break down barriers to mental healthcare through AI-powered support
- **Personalization**: Deliver tailored therapeutic responses based on individual needs and emotional states
- **Integration**: Seamlessly combine digital therapeutics with traditional mental health services
- **Scalability**: Provide consistent mental health support at scale without compromising quality

### Target Audience
- College students and young adults experiencing stress and mental health challenges
- Individuals in underserved communities with limited access to traditional therapy
- People seeking anonymous, judgment-free mental health support
- Healthcare systems looking to expand therapeutic capabilities

## Technical Architecture

MindBridge follows a modern microservices architecture with clear separation of concerns across frontend, backend AI services, and machine learning components.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Web Application Frontend] --> B[Next.js Application]
    B --> C[API Gateway Layer]
    C --> D[AI Backend Services]
    C --> E[ML Backend Services]
    
    D --> F[Groq AI Service]
    D --> G[TTS Service]
    D --> H[Avatar Service]
    D --> I[RAG System]
    
    E --> J[Mental Health Analytics]
    E --> K[Text Classification Models]
    
    F --> L[Therapeutic Responses]
    G --> M[Voice Synthesis]
    H --> N[Interactive Avatars]
    I --> O[Knowledge Retrieval]
    
    B --> P[User Authentication]
    B --> Q[Session Management]
    B --> R[Analytics Dashboard]
    
    S[Database Layer] --> T[Prisma ORM]
    S --> U[MySQL Database]
    
    V[External APIs] --> W[Groq AI]
    V --> X[ElevenLabs TTS]
    V --> Y[Pinecone Vector Store]
```

### Component Breakdown

The platform consists of three primary architectural layers:

**Frontend Layer (WEBAPP)**
- Next.js-based React application with TypeScript
- Modern UI components built with Radix UI primitives
- Real-time chat interface with WebSocket connectivity
- Responsive design supporting desktop and mobile platforms

**AI Services Layer (ai-backend)**
- FastAPI-based microservices architecture
- Modular service design for AI, TTS, and avatar generation
- Async processing for concurrent user requests
- RESTful API endpoints for frontend integration

**Machine Learning Layer (ml-backend)**
- Text classification and sentiment analysis
- Mental health analytics and insights
- Data preprocessing and model training pipelines

### Design Patterns

The architecture implements several key design patterns:

- **Microservices Pattern**: Separate AI, TTS, and avatar services for scalability
- **Repository Pattern**: Database abstraction through Prisma ORM
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates for chat and session management
